about_the_game:
🕯️ About the Game:

Trapped in a nightmarish labyrinth, you have only two goals, find the ancient book and escape.
But the walls are alive with echoes, and the monsters that stalk the corridors never sleep.

The Abyssal Maze is a three stage horror maze that tests your nerves, patience, and survival instincts. You have no weapons, no powers, only your wits and your ears.

🔦 Gameplay Features

  • Three Increasingly Difficult Stages:
    Each maze grows larger, darker, and more twisted. The third stage is nearly impossible, only the most determined will survive.

  • Stealth Over Strength:
    You can’t fight the monsters. You can only listen, and run.

  • Dynamic Audio Cues:
    Hear the growls of roaming monsters and use those sounds to avoid them before they find you.

  • Hidden Secrets:
    Every stage hides a mysterious book. Only by finding it and the exit can you progress to the next nightmare.

  • Atmospheric Horror:
    Oppressive sound design, and unpredictable patrols keep you on edge from start to finish.

Do you have what it takes to escape the maze… or will you become part of it?
